'''''Otospermum''''' is a [[genus]] of flowering plants in the [[Anthemideae|chamomile tribe]] within the [[Asteraceae|daisy family]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/33562784#page/267/mode/1up Willkomm, Heinrich Moritz. 1864. Botanische Zeitung. Berlin 22: 251] descriptions in Latin, commentary in German</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Otospernum M. Wilkomm |url=https://www.tropicos.org/Name/40035004 |access-date=2022-03-27 |website=www.tropicos.org}}</ref>

;Species
The only known species is '''''Otospermum glabrum''''', native to [[France]], [[Spain]], [[Portugal]], [[Morocco]], [[Algeria]], [[Tunisia]], and [[Libya]].<ref name=t>[http://dixon.iplantcollaborative.org/CompositaeWeb/Default.aspx?Page=NameDetails&TabNum=3&nameId=2b936483-dae2-44a9-a30a-8e196148f15c Flann, C (ed) 2009+ Global Compositae Checklist ]</ref>
